title: Chat slash command
description: chat.command@1: one command the OpenVibe.Chat composer offers. A registered command's name (one to 32 lowercase letters, digits, underscores or dashes, starting with a letter), a plain-sentence description of at most 100 characters, and its typed options in order; source says who registered it (builtin, app or actor) and application_id names the app or actor for a registration. Chat serves the built-in list at GET /api/chat/commands (query q filters by name) and an option's choices at GET /api/chat/commands/autocomplete, both behind the default-off CHAT_SLASH_COMMANDS_ENABLED switch. An execution still runs through the socket's authenticated command pipeline with the sender's own rights, so moderating commands keep the moderation checks; an unknown command is answered with a plain sentence.
